meta.enumeration: every window of 2-3 consecutive first-parent commits that are all feat commits of one plan (plan = feature-feasibility sub-range F01-F16, else the linked plan) with backend/src lines 250-800 (git diff base..end); 88 windows. Added afterwards for the prereg-v1 candidate set: 10 windows inside the 16 sub-ranges that contain a test-only commit or lie inside f08/f14/f15 (93 in all; 5 of them were already listed and are now graded). Windows outside 300-700 or containing a t01-t15/p01/p02/f08/f14/f15 commit were not graded.
meta.grading: harness grade.original_patch_errors (original base..end patch graded on a fresh workspace) and the harness grade of an unchanged base workspace (null patch: hidden tests must fail, regressions = old tests that fail at base once support files from end are restored, expected when fakes changed). F03_47-48 and F04 with the diff minus **/superpowers/** because the harness strips those paths before git apply.
meta.names: coupling = tasks/feature-feasibility coupling.py/fakes_contract.py method applied to the window (new src symbols imported by hidden tests + by restored support files + new public fake methods); heuristic = identifiers/strings used by graded test code that occur in backend/src at end but nowhere at base. Threshold medium <= ~20, checked by a full count for every candidate that passed grading.
meta.selection_inputs: task-construction criteria only; no agent was run on any candidate
meta.selection_rule: Amended 2026-11-15 after the candidate scan and before any AI run (prereg/prereg-v1.1-draft.md): criteria 1-9 (one plan, no test/refactor/chore/docs commit, backend only, 300-700 src lines, no commit shared with t01-t15/p01/p02/f08/f14/f15, original patch grades clean, >=5 graded hidden tests fail at base, integration-only share <=50% (medium_coverage.py), <=20 required names (medium_names.py)); greedy max 5, no shared commit, order (names, src lines, end hash); pass 1 one per layer domain/application/infrastructure/api, pass 2 fills from all eligible (medium_select.py). The first draft's hand-picked verdicts are kept per window under previous_selection.
